title: Annotated Gemini orbital photo #17: Guadalupe Peak, Salt Basin and Delaware Mts., Texas
description: Black-and-white orbital terrain photograph on a white mount card, marked "#17" with "N" at top. Handwritten labels include "Guadalupe Mts.", "Guadalupe Peak", "Salt Basin", "Delaware Mts.", "Apache Mts.", "Davis Mts.", "Quitman Mts.", "Rio Grande R." and "U.S. MEXICO". Faint show-through handwriting, apparently including "NASA HQ", is visible in the upper right corner.
